preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The number of rows n and columns m must each be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i][j] <= 10**9 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each cell value a[i][j] must be a positive integer between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The total number of cells across all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout.split()) == 2 and all(1 <= int(x) <= m for x in stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to make the grid good, output -1; otherwise, output two integers representing the indices of the columns to swap.

postconditions.expression: any(a[i][j] >= a[i][j-1] for i in range(n) for j in range(1, m))
postconditions.description: After the swap, each row must be sorted in non-decreasing order.
